comment: Every message and error code the engine emits (plan §16). The engine never builds sentences: it emits {code, params} and each client renders the text from <lang>.json (en.json is the reference). tools/check-contracts.py checks that every code has English text, that the text uses exactly the declared parameters with matching formats, and that every code used by the other contracts and the scenarios exists here.

kinds.error: A BroError code: why a job, step or request failed. 'http' is the status the server answers with when it is returned by an API route.
kinds.log: A job or engine log line; 'severity' is its default.
kinds.progress: The operation a job is doing (ctx.progress), shown next to its progress.
kinds.reason: A part of another message, passed as a parameter of type message (title rules, rip checks, causes).
kinds.label: The display name of a value (an outcome, a mode, a drive state).
kinds.issue: A configuration validation issue (ConfigValidator, with a JSON path).
kinds.problem: A ProblemService kind: shown as a banner until it is cleared. Problems can also be errors.
kinds.notification: Title or body of a notification.
kinds.note: Text of an INCOMPLETE / READ ERRORS note file.

paramTypes.int: An integer; may be used with plural.
paramTypes.bool: true / false; used with select (keys true and other).
paramTypes.path: A file or folder path, shown as is.
paramTypes.bytes: A byte count, rendered with {x, bytes} like a file manager (1.2 GB).
paramTypes.duration: Seconds, rendered with {x, duration} as h:mm:ss (m:ss under an hour) or with {x, durationPrecise} as h:mm:ss.sss.
paramTypes.day: A calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD, rendered as the locale's short date (en: as is).
paramTypes.list: A list of strings, rendered joined with ', '.
paramTypes.message: A nested BroMessage {code, params}, rendered from the catalogue.
paramTypes.messages: A list of BroMessages, rendered and joined with '; '.

rendering: Texts are ICU MessageFormat: {x}, {x, plural, one {…} other {…}} (also =0), {x, select, a {…} other {…}}, plus the custom formats bytes, duration and durationPrecise.
A BroError with a cause renders as '<error> (<cause>)'.
MakeMKV's own messages (makemkv.message) keep MakeMKV's English text; they are not translated.
File and folder names made by Naming (archive names, episode fallbacks) are never translated: they are part of the archive format.
